note: Animals, step B (Radar; Steve-approved plan 2026-10-21, design items/ANIMALS_DESIGN.md): one species, the rabbit. Server-owned records, no physics; they walk with the shared steering module (src/shared/steering.gd). Each player keeps up to target_per_player of a species within active_radius_m; new ones appear spawn_min_m to spawn_max_m from the player (out of sight) and never within never_within_m of any player; none are saved. Beyond active_radius_m from every player an animal is frozen (not ticked); beyond despawn_m it is dropped. Tick rates by distance to the nearest player: hz_near within near_m, hz_mid within mid_m, hz_far beyond. AI work per server tick is capped at tick_budget_ms (a quarter of the animals are looked at each tick, the rest wait). Caps: per_player_cap animals counted near one player, server_cap in all. Rabbit: grazes, hops a few metres, bolts away from a player within spook_m until safe_m, then settles. No hunting yet (damage and carcass come next). Deer (species 2, build 478): live in herds of 3 to 6; when one bolts the others follow after alarm_s seconds (the first to see a player is the sentinel). Health 20: three spear jabs. Build 480 (Tyler report 16): an animal that notices a player within alert_m (but not yet spook_m) freezes and watches for alert_s, then relaxes or bolts; a bolt zigzags (zig_deg every zig_leg_m), sprints for burst_s and then trots at trot_share of the sprint speed; herd members that stray beyond herd_pull_m graze back toward the herd centre. Build 492: senses block. A player is perceived at distance / factor: downwind of the player (the wind carries scent to the animal) factor up to 1 + scent_gain x wind, upwind down to 0.5; crouch 0.6, sit 0.8, lying 0.5; with terrain between the animal's eye and the player (sampled every los_step_m) and the player beyond always_notice_m the factor is multiplied by blind_factor. Rabbits own a burrow (their spawn spot): a bolt within burrow_m and away from the threat runs for it, the rabbit goes to ground for hide_s and is neither sent nor huntable until it comes out. Blood trail (build 493): a wounded animal drops blood every every_m while it runs (at most max_drops each, max_total on the map, dry after life_s seconds); the server sends the drops near each player as protocol 55 blood points. Habitat (build 495): a new animal tries habitat_tries spots; a spot is refused when steeper than slope_max (rise over run_m in four directions), more than above_player_m higher than the player, or within water_edge_m of deep water; a deer prefers a spot under trees when tree data is loaded there. Forest sight: a line of sight under tree crowns loses up to forest_block of its visibility (trees do not fully block it). Bleeding out (build 508): a wounded animal bleeds by its hit (blood.note_wounded) and dies where it is when it runs out (the carcass lies at the end of its trail; a deer hit once for 8 of its 20 health has about 90 s), so a hunter can follow the drops to it. Wolves (build 509, items/WOLF_CARD.md decisions): species wolf is a pack animal (pack_size); server_wolves.gd owns its brain and the wolves block here is every number. natural false = admin spawn only until Dave wants wild packs (one home per cell_m square, cell_share of cells, respawn_s after a wipe, never inside exclude [x, z, radius]).

spyglass.note: The admin spyglass (Ctrl+Shift+L, docs/design/spyglass_design.md): while an admin looks through it the animals within send_radius_m are sent, nearest cap (the client draws as many). 300 m is despawn_m: every animal kept round a player.

hit_send_m_note: A hit (animal id and body zone) is sent to every player within hit_send_m of the animal (docs/design/hunt_feedback_server.md).
rewind_max_ms_note: Protocol 155 (Dave 23 Nov 2026: 'battle was almost impossible'): a player's blow is judged where their screen showed the animal, at most this far back. The screen shows animals about 0.35 s behind (the row clock's delay, 0.1 to 0.8 s) plus half the ping, so 500 ms covers a normal internet game; a client claiming more is judged at 500 ms back (no hitting an animal that left long since).
dodge_view_ms_note: A fair dodge (defend rows with fair_dodge; robots over 60 and 120 ms links with loss, 23 Nov 2026: 0 of 9 side-steps from a goblin or bandit got clear): a blow on a player is judged dodge_view_ms plus the link's round trip after the server's blow, against where the player then is, so a step the player made while their screen showed the strike counts. Every animal that defends itself has it too since 23 Nov 2026 (coordinator for Dave: fights must be fair and playable; test_animal_fights.gd: with the rows as they were, a player who stepped aside as soon as the warning showed dodged no moose, buffalo, rhino, elephant, lion, tiger or alligator charge at all, even on a 0 ms link; with it, nearly every one). dodge_view_ms is how far behind the player's screen draws the server (the row clock's delay plus the trip down, about 0.35 s); dodge_late_max_ms caps it, so a slow or lying link cannot stretch it.
warn_min_s_note: Every charge is warned for at least this long, a growl and the head-down stand (Dave 23 Nov 2026: animals growl before attacking; coordinator: about 1 s, long enough to hear, turn and react). A player running off or a blow during the warning shortens a warning to no less; a hunter's chase of a runner has no stand, it roars as it sets off. server_big_game.gd.
close_attacks_note: A defend row's strike (a swipe, bite, horn, tusk or stomp) and kick (a donkey's or goat's, behind it): a warning that ends with its foe within contact_m + start_m ends in that blow instead of a charge, kick first. start_m is 0.2 m inside reach_m, so a player who stands still is struck and one who steps back or aside in the wind-up is not. It stands wound up windup_s (the client plays the model's own attack clip, models.json strike/strike2/kick roles), then lands damage_x of the row's damage on a player still within contact_m + reach_m inside arc_deg of where it faces (behind it for a kick), then recovers recover_s. Only kinds whose models have attack clips (animal-fights/MODEL_ATTACKS_2026-11-23.md; Dave 23 Nov 2026: make sure to use models that have the actions we need). server_big_game.gd _close_attack.
strike_min_s_note: A charge's blow lands only once the charge has run this long (a defend row's own strike_min_s wins), so every screen draws the lunge before the blow (robots over 120 ms, 23 Nov 2026: a warthog charging from 1 m hit 0.18 s in, drawn 1.7 to 2.8 m short of the player). Raised from 0.35 to 0.6 (robots over 120 ms, 23 Nov 2026: a rhino charging from 3.6 m struck 0.33 s in, its charge row drawn 0.1 s after the blow); a charge set off close is paced to reach the player as the blow may land. Goblins and bandits keep their own 0.35. server_big_game.gd.

bear.note_flee: Dave 25 Nov 2026 play test: a bear "should be able to out run me", he chased one down on foot and stabbed it (flee 9.0 m/s, the player runs 9.0, and after its 6 s burst it trotted at half). Bears run 48 to 56 km/h in bursts (NPS Staying Safe Around Bears; North American Bear Center): flee_mps 13 to 14, a 10 s burst, then a lope (trot_share 0.85) still faster than the player's 9 m/s run, in long straight legs (zig 10 degrees, 40 m: a bear crashes off through the brush, it does not jink like a deer), and it keeps going 120 m. The way to take one is to learn to trap it (Dave).

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.note: Dave 7 Nov 2026 (docs/GOBLINS.md): 2 to 5 goblins live in a river-side cave (a spring cave mouth), never one that has a bear in or near it. They bed down at the mouth by day (active) and come out at night; skittish: they watch from the edge of firelight (alert) and run, but fight if cornered or threatened at their den. Den life (docs/design/goblin_den_life_design.md, den_life): by day they sleep in the den inside the cave, walking the cave floor path; at night they come out, creep to the edge of a fire's light to watch (watch_spook_m), or forage at berry bushes without stripping them. Stealing (docs/design/goblin_stealing_design.md): one small unlit loose thing at a time, carried to a pile in the den; a killed goblin drops it; no new band while a burning fire is within lair.guard_m of the mouth. Still to build: fighting bears, friendship. Two models (Skritch, Rukz) are picked per goblin on the client; height 1.1 m +-0.5 m, bell-shaped, from the animal id.

den_life.dog_back_note: MikeW's DOG_REACTIONS.md (dog_companion_design.md 11): a barking dog within dog_back_m makes a goblin step back dog_back_step_m, face it and hold dog_back_s; two barking dogs make it flee; a silent dog does nothing.

rhino.note: Batch 4, savanna (Dave 7 Nov 2026: add every animal we own). A rhinoceros grazes the savanna alone or in twos, sees poorly, and charges anything that comes close. Wild ox numbers, heavier, solitary, shorter-sighted and quicker to charge.

alligator.name: Alligator
alligator.note: Dave 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/ALLIGATOR_SWIMMING.md): an alligator lives in the fresh water of marsh and slow rivers and on their banks, rides the surface, basks on the bank and ambushes: it attacks a swimming player and anyone at the water's edge (decided by the coordinator for Dave). Black bear defend rows reshaped for an ambush predator: short warning, long reach in water, one hard bite.

bandit.name: Bandit
bandit.note: Bandit camps stage 2 (Dave 19 Nov 2026, docs/design/BANDIT_CAMPS.md): only ever made at an awake camp by server_bandits.gd (target_per_player 0), levelled by the camp's distance from the town; its step is the camp's (server_bandits.step): it sits or stands by the fire, fights back when hit (this defend row, the big game charge, never lethal) and runs when badly hurt. No carcass; it drops its weapon and clothes. Drawn as the human ragdoll (bandit_look.gd). First values, tune after play (BANDIT-8..14).

flight.note: Single birds in flight, step 1 (docs/design/bird_flight_server_design.md; MikeW's client layer): a species row with a flight block flies when it bolts. flush: sits tight to flush_m, bursts up climb_m in burst_s, flies fly_m at fly_mps bending to cover, glides the last glide_share down, lands and runs run_m. perch: flies to tree cover fly_m off and sits perch_up_m up for perch_s, then comes down once nobody is within safe_m. Every flight stays clear_m over the ground except where it lands. Wire: 15 flying, 17 gliding.

dogs.note: A player's companion dog as a presence for wild animals (dog_companion_design.md 11; MikeW, docs/design/DOG_REACTIONS.md): species rows with a dog block react to it; a dog that barked within bark_s is sensed bark_x farther.

weather.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/animals_in_weather_design.md, step 1; research docs/knowledge/animals-in-weather.md, Jamie): weather tilts behaviour by a species row's weather role (deer, stock, small, bird, hunter). Wind: jumpy roles spook and alert up to wind_spook_max times farther by wind_spook_at; small animals lose small_wind_cut of their activity above small_wind_from and small_wind_cut_high above small_wind_high, and go down their burrows that often; hunters hunt hunter_wind_x more; deer and hunters wander into the wind (upwind_share, within upwind_spread_deg) below gale_from. A storm (storm_from) or snowfall (snowfall_from) cuts activity to storm_activity_x and wander to storm_wander_x. A storm in any of ahead_hours (sampled every ahead_every_s real seconds) makes birds, small animals and deer feed ahead_feed_x more and skip their daytime rest. Mist and fog cut sight by distance (fog below).
weather.step2_note: Step 2 (animals_in_weather_design.md 6 and 7): in rain (rain_from) deer and stock stand out hunch_share of their grazing spells (wire state 20); deer in rain or a gale and half the stock in rain move home to tree cover within cover_m (deer in a gale with no trees: lower ground), and walk back cover_return_s real seconds (one game hour) after it passes; in a gale stock face downwind and drift at drift_mps.
weather.cover_stand_note: Design 11 (MikeW, ANIMAL_WEATHER_LOOKS.md): a deer or stock animal grazing within cover_stand_m of the cover home it moved to, or under tree crowns, is sent hunched (state 20) for as long as the rain, a gale or the cold lasts. Midday heat in the shade is not a hunch.
weather.step3_note: Step 3 (design 9): wolves in wolf_snow_from snow or more walk and trot wolf_snow.speed_x as fast and prowl wolf_snow.roam_x as far (the chase is unchanged); deer below cold_c air (seasonal temp_c less lapse_c_per_m) or in snow_cold_from snowfall move home to tree crowns in conifer_biomes, else lower ground; stock in hot_c air between heat_hours go to shade. All return cover_return_s after it passes.

fog.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/animals_in_fog_server.md; Jamie docs/knowledge/fog-and-visibility.md; MikeW ANIMAL_FOG.md). Always on with the weather rules (Dave 8 Nov: no flags). Since 14 Nov 2026 (Dave's fog instruction: fog cuts sight, not hearing; docs/design/FOG_PLAN.md part 3) the fog at a point is Weather.fog_shape, the depth fog the client draws, over the cold-air floor (fog_ground.gd) and the sea fog over the land; V is where it takes 95 %: about 2.8 km clear, 460 m in heavy rain, 52 m deep in full fog. Sight: all of a player while the fog takes under sight_full_fog of the view, none once it takes sight_gone_fog (Jamie's V/4 and V/2 for exponential fog, the same contrasts: about 31 and 42 m in full fog), then only hearing and smell (senses.blind_factor). Wolves shadow at min(stalk_m, max(V/2, wolf_min_m)). Under sit_below_m (100: fog of strength 0.85 and up, the old 250 m threshold's fog) perched birds stay up and birds and sit_species wander bird_wander_x as far. Under deer_v_m (1400: fog of strength 0.17 and up, as the old 1000 m) deer keep dusk hours deer_late_h past 08:00 and try edge_tries hops for open ground with crowns within edge_m; stock and deer herd_pull_m and wander x herd_x.

reactions.startle_note: Dave 23 Nov 2026: animals look up and stare at the player before running away. One grazing or walking that a player comes within its flee distance of stares at them first: startle_s[1] seconds for a player at the flee distance, down to startle_s[0] as they come nearer or run at it; within startle_close_m, hurt, or already watching, it bolts at once. A species row may set its own startle_s. server_animals.gd _stares.
reactions.note: PROVISIONAL RX-1 (Dave 19 Nov 2026 play test: animals must react to a nearby player from reasonable distances; values for his review, docs/design/ANIMAL_REACTIONS.md). Every species' reaction distances in one place, [notice_m, flee_m, safe_m]: within notice_m an animal stops and watches (alert_m), within flee_m it runs (spook_m), and it runs until safe_m away. These are distances to a standing player in the open on a calm day; the senses block stretches or shrinks them (wind, stance, trees, ground between, noise, a running player). server_animals.setup copies them into each species row as alert_m, spook_m and safe_m. Changed 19 Nov from the old rows: deer 50/30/60 to 60/35/70, elk 55/35/70 to 70/40/80.

senses.reactions_note: PROVISIONAL RX-2 and RX-3 (Dave 19 Nov 2026): scent_loss is how much an animal upwind of a player loses (was the same 0.5 as scent_gain, which halved its eyes and ears too); a player moving at run_ms or faster (running; the walk is 3.2 m/s) is sensed run_x farther, by eye and ear.
senses.action_heard_note: Hearing-range pass (23 Nov 2026, docs/SOUND_MAP.md 'Who hears what, how far'): for LOUD_HOLD_MS (5 s) after an axe or pick blow, a cry of pain, a shovel dig or a craft's work (server_action_cues.gd loud_kinds) an animal senses that player this many times farther, whatever their stance or cover (it never makes them nearer than they would seem anyway). Kept at or under far_factor, past which no player is sensed. A deer (notice 60, flee 35) notices a woodcutter at 84 m and runs from 49 m; a rabbit (24, 14) at 34 and 20.

hunger.note: ANIMAL_SCENARIOS gap 10 (25 Nov 2026; Dave: a bear "should have run away unless it was starving or trapped"): a species with a hunger row is born starving at its row's season chance (spring after the den and late winter for bears; winter for the northern cats). A starving one does not run from a player: it stands its ground and warns by the ladder at threat_x its threat range, whatever its temperament; it comes for food left out (this thief row: it is not put off by a player beyond scare_m) and takes it away to eat. It never comes into a fire's or a torch's light. A poor food year is not modelled yet.

blood.note_drops: max_drops 40 -> 400 and max_total 200 -> 600 (coordinator for Dave, 23 Nov 2026: "I love the idea the animal is bleeding and if they bleed enough they die eventually"; test_animal_fights.gd): an elk hurt by one spear blow walked on 21 m past its fortieth drop before it died, so its trail stopped short of the body. Each drop still fades after life_s, so the trail is the last few minutes of its walk.
blood.note_wounded: ANIMAL_SCENARIOS gap 8 (25 Nov 2026): each wound bleeds its own damage again over bleed_s, so a hit of half its health ends it in about a minute and a graze in many, and never slower than its whole health over bleed_max_s (the old flat 0.15 a second killed a deer of 20 in 2 minutes and an elephant of 300 in 33, whatever the hit); hurt, its lope after the burst is wounded_speed_x as fast (a deer 10 m/s becomes 7, a player can keep up); once no player is within safe_m it runs on bed_m[0] metres, and up to bed_m[1] looking for trees, then lies up for bed_s (server_animals._runs_on_hurt). A player within its flee distance pushes it on.

ground_step.note: Provisional GS-1 (Dave 19 Nov 2026 play test, animals in dug ground): the most an animal jumps down (drop_m) or scrambles up (climb_m) in one step, whatever the slope, so a dug hole's steep rim is not a wall (server_animals.walk_step). Only where a dig or fill touches the step; natural ground keeps the slope rule. Deeper holes stay pits.

nests.note: Inland bird nests (MikeW 3 Nov; eggs and seasons in data/items/nests.json, Sal): one roll per cell_m square per kind, chance x the species biome weight; grouse on open ground, songbirds under trees or bushes; never steeper than slope_max.

island_level.note: Starter island levels (Dave 6 Nov 2026, corrected 17:20): every animal has a level. Species live wherever is natural for them (biome, water, terrain); the island only sets their level. island_level is 0 within town_m of the town point (the middle of the starter town's NPC markers, data/npcs/markers.json; never the spawn, 9 Nov 2026) and 1 at far_m, about the far coast of tile 3,4. An animal's level is drawn from levels.town near the town, levels.middle half way across and levels.far on the far side (blended between). Each level above 1 adds hp_per_level to its health and damage_per_level to its hit.

drink.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/animals_at_water_server.md; client half docs/design/animals_drink_client_design.md; drinking_water_design.md #719). Always on (Dave 8 Nov: no flags; the drink.on switch is gone, 9 Nov). At dawn and dusk (the dusk period) a deer or stock animal (roles) goes, with the chance chance once a twilight, to the nearest fresh water edge within reach_m of its home (rings ring_m apart in bearings directions; ground above the sea; wet_m deep), stands there stand_s real seconds drinking (wire state 21: the client plays its role 21 clip, a drink, eat or graze clip, and lifts the head now and then to look round), and goes home; it gives up after max_legs legs. One search is kept per 50 m cell for cache_s. Wolf packs prowl wolf_back_m back from the water nearest home within wolf_water_m, within wolf_ring_m, at those hours. Springs first waits for the baked drink rows (#719 step 2).
drink.spring_note: Springs first (Dave 9 Nov 2026, docs/design/spring_heads_lower_design.md 3): drink_spot takes the nearest ground spring within reach, standing spring_stand_m out from the head on the side the animal comes from; at a spring it also grazes spring_graze_s more in the green round it. Wolves wait for the prey there too.

ice.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/animals_on_ice_server.md; Jamie docs/knowledge/animals-on-ice-and-snow.md #736; MikeW ANIMAL_WEATHER_LOOKS.md ice; Kathleen frozen_water_look.md #729). Always on (Dave 8 Nov: no flags; the ice.on switch is gone, 9 Nov). Ice is the server's Ice.cover at 3 m (as the players'), h cm = cover x 20, open in a thaw moat, kept per 1 km band and 5 m of height for cache_s. Ice holds an animal for sure when mass_kg <= sure_k x h^2 (Jamie, Minnesota DNR; it may break up to break_k x h^2; animals keep off doubtful ice, judged). Deer-role animals and skirt_species never step on ice of skirt_cover or more (deer fall on bare ice), even in shallows they would wade; any other species in mass_kg walks on ice that holds it, at the water surface. A water flock on ice that holds it (flock_mass_kg when unlisted) stands edge_back_m back from the nearest water whose ice would not, within edge_search_m, or does not settle there. Starter ice (2.8 to 5.6 cm) holds crows, rabbits and foxes, never a wolf for sure.
ice.mass_note: Jamie #736: raven 1.2 (crow), hare 3.5 (rabbit), fox 6, wolf 40. Duck 1.1, goose 4 and seabird 1 are judged, not from the page.

thunder.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/birds_and_thunder_server.md; MikeW). Always on since 9 Nov: the client plays its thunder from the same shared schedule (src/shared/thunder.gd; Kathleen's weather_sounds.gd, #849), so the birds flush at the claps the player hears. A bird with a flight row or a water flock within flush_m of a strike takes off away from it when the sound arrives (sound_mps): state 15.

wolves.natural_note: Wild packs are always on (Dave 8 Nov 2026, decision 4; docs/design/wolf_packs_and_pups_design.md). The natural switch is gone (9 Nov, no flags): one pack home per cell_m cell, cell_share of the cells.
wolves.town_keep_note: Coordinator for Dave, 22 Nov 2026: within town_keep_m of the starter town's markers (server_npcs.gd town_point, never the spawn) packs do not stalk, rush or hunt, and a rush breaks off. Behaviour only: no den is moved.
wolves.dog_note: MikeW's DOG_REACTIONS.md (dog_companion_design.md 11): a pack goes for a player's dog within distract_m before any deer, and bites it dog_bite every dog_bite_s through the damage hook.

pups.note: Dave 8 Nov 2026, decisions 3 and 4 (docs/design/wolf_packs_and_pups_design.md). A natural pack made between day-of-year days[0] and days[1] has count pups at its den (sent as young, hp_x of a wolf's health). They stay within play_m of the den and play by day; a player within hide_m who stands or moves sends them into the den. A player within guard_m of the den while the pack is alive: the pack comes home and warns for warn_s, then rushes one still within rush_m (a torch, a campfire and a second player hold it, Dave 25 Nov 2026). A killed pack's pups are orphans for orphan_days game days (the den gets no new pack meanwhile). (The old den keep-out is gone; wolves.town_keep_m is now behaviour only: no stalk, rush or hunt near the town markers.)
pups.say_warn: Wolves snarl at you from near their den.

wolves.ring_note: The battle ring (Dave 23 Nov 2026: animals "so robotic", "not actually acting like animals"; server_wolves _ring_turns): in a rush each wolf keeps a place ring_m round the player, drifting ring_rad_s; lunge_at_once wolves (one more for every extra_lunge_per in the pack) take a turn at a time: a still crouched wind-up of windup_s (the tell), one lunge of at most lunge_s for one bite, recover_s standing where it bit, within lunge_reach_m (the opening to strike it, well inside a spear's 3 m even drawn late; robots 23 Nov 2026: a lone player was maimed in 11 to 19 s and the wolf was near only for the lunge), then back_s backing off to its place; a wolf waits turn_gap_s before its next turn. Judged numbers, to be tuned in play.
wolves.say_stolen: The wolves tear your meat away and run off with it.
wolves.say_watched: Something is watching you from the trees.
wolves.say_rush: The wolves are coming for you!

temperament.note: Dave 6 Nov 2026: every animal has an inherent temperament. Passive ones hide or run at all costs; neutral ones ignore us; aggressive ones attack; some are friendly, as in the real wild. A species row's 'temperament' gives the share of each kind it is born with (none = all defensive). spook_x scales how close a player may come before it runs (0 = it never runs), threat_x scales its defend.threat_m (0 = never attacks there), attacks false = never attacks unless defending its young, alert false = it does not stop to watch. bluff_x scales a species' defend.bluff_share (how often a charge is a bluff; docs/design/bear_threat_design.md). Seasons and young change these further (species 'seasons', 'young').
